description: The pie chart, titled “6 Matches,” visually represents the distribution of occurrences across seven distinct categories, labeled 0 through 6, presumably indicating the number of matches in a dataset context related to the paper “Fair-PP: A Synthetic Dataset for Aligning LLM with Personalized Preferences of Social Equity.” The largest segment corresponds to category “6 Matches,” occupying 27.2% of the chart (8006 instances), followed by category “2” at 22.4% (6583 instances). Category “1” accounts for 13.8% (4046 instances), and category “0” for 13.3% (3910 instances). Smaller segments include category “5” at 10.4% (3043 instances), category “3” at 6.8% (2002 instances), and category “4” at 6.2% (1810 instances). Each slice is color-coded with pastel shades—blue for “6,” light green for “2,” yellow for “1,” beige for “0,” cyan for “5,” olive for “3,” and light blue for “4”—and labeled with both percentage and absolute count. The chart does not include a legend, but the labels are placed adjacent to or inside their respective slices, and no slice is exploded or emphasized beyond its proportional size. The segments are arranged in a clockwise order starting from the top, roughly by descending size, though not strictly ordered.
